q: How far ahead should I order?
a: At least three weeks before you want delivery. That gives us time to confirm availability and complete vaccinations before your stock leaves the farm.

q: Can you supply feed and brooding equipment with my order?
a: Yes. We can bundle feed, vaccines and brooding kits with your stock and deliver them on the same day.

q: What help do I get after delivery?
a: Our field officers and partner vets stay on call for health checks, mortality investigations and performance comparisons for the whole cycle. Day-old chick orders include WhatsApp support for the first 14 days.
